_specs_source: Vossen HF6-4 (Y-pattern, deep concave). Listed production size 20x9.5, ET+30, 6x139.7, CB 106.1, Deep (threepiece.us / blackopsautoworks.com listings, vossenwheels.com/wheel/hf6-4). Overall width ~ 9.5J + two flanges (estimate). Spoke planform, lip radius (spokes reach ~255 mm, no lip-face pockets) and stem slots measured on the official straight-on front image (vossenwheels.com/wheel/hf6-4, Terra Bronze front, 2026-09-24; window IoU 0.90). Spoke cross-section (narrow top, steep chamfered flanks) is not modelled yet.
